class_id: a printed figure dropped by a numbers-only guard at the persister boundary
feature: every document child-table figure the Python extractor returns as the text the document printed (peer_companies today: pe, pe_basic, eps_basic, eps_diluted, eps_basic_and_diluted, ronw_pct, nav, pb), for every IPO with a document peer table (MAINBOARD and SME, every status), rows written before and after the fix
symptom: the reader returns cells as printed strings by design ('1,19,694.32', '22.85%', '(3.45)'), and the persister's guard accepted JS numbers only, so every printed figure became null with no log line and no reason: the set was saved names-only and looked like a document that printed no figures. Wider shape: a type guard written for one producer (the ad path emits floats) silently turns a second producer's valid values into absence.
first_seen: 2026-09-26 -- IPODhan #1165 (found by the #545 round, PR #1161; spec F-186). Measured 2026-10-01 by running extract_filing.run() on the committed real fixtures: German Green Steel and Power RHP returns 5 peers with printed eps_basic/eps_diluted/ronw_pct/nav (e.g. Beekay Steel '18.94'/'18.94'/'3.49'/'548.18') and Green Asia Impex RHP 3 peers incl. ronw_pct '22.85%'; before the fix all 8 persisted with every figure null. A-One Steels RHP/DRHP peer pages alone yield no table peers (the text path, names only).
fix_prs: #1165/#1166 branch fix/1165-1166-document-peers: scraper/src/services/printed-number.ts parsePrintedNumber is the one conversion point (commas incl. lakh grouping, brackets and leading minus as negative, %/x/times suffixes, footnote marks, placeholders as absent); an unparseable cell is null AND listed in the summary's skipped_failed_check with its printed text plus a warn log.
detection_check: CI regression guard only: scraper/tests/unit/services/filing-persister-printed-peer-figures.test.ts (red on the numbers-only guard) and the German Green case in scraper/tests/integration/rhp-promoters-peers-persist.integration.test.ts (real extractor -> real persister -> ipodhan_test, run with child consolidation ON and OFF). No nightly data check yet: the audit #1165 asks for (document vs Chittorgarh figures for the same peer, flagged over a tolerance) is not built, so a misread column on a live document is not detected.
